report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency issues, but current telemetry shows healthy gateway checkout (status OK, 66ms), error_rate 0.001, p95 79ms, and no dependency timeouts or pool waiters across gateway, order, and payment. Order shows retained heap after GC with a 6-minute-old deploy, but no latency/error signal and no memory-retention history, so no bounded root cause is established.
missing_evidence: Time-series of checkout error rate and p95 latency to confirm the alert is real
Chronological memory-retention series for order to assess leak trend
Evidence linking order retained heap to checkout latency or errors
Trace spans covering order and payment downstream of checkout
